note: Three curated resources are live-change-and-rollback-verified against Orchestrator 9.7.0.43282: appliance/banners and appliance/bgp (ECOS 9.7.0.0_109184, 2026-08-30) — a real change applied, verified on the appliance, confirmed, rolled back, and persisted to flash at both ends — and appliance-info (2026-09-02), an Orchestrator-side object changed, verified, rolled back byte-identical and re-read from a fresh session. Three more are live-no-op-write-verified and 33 are live-read-verified. Level 5 is the floor for calling a write path supported, so exactly three write paths in this repository have met that floor; every other write is still code that has not been applied and rolled back on real gear. A programmatic equivalent of the level-4 check passed for 33 write-capable kinds with zero phantom drift, recorded as supporting evidence in docs/sitrep/2026-08-30-live-read.md rather than promoted, because the ledger records levels by the procedure actually run. Three kinds stay at mock-verified because nothing of that kind is configured on the observed fabric. docs/live-validation.md is the protocol, including the four failure paths level 6 needs and that none has exercised.

Full level-5 cycle on S1-ecv-02 (13.NE): motd changed under a 10-minute confirm window, verified present on the appliance with `issue` untouched, confirmed, rolled back, and the result byte-identical to the pre-change baseline. hasUnsavedChanges was False after both the apply and the rollback, so both reached flash. Template-owned, so the write needed --override-template: the `banners` template body IS the banner text, which is ownership being correct rather than over-scoped. The endpoint rejects non-ASCII (400 on an em-dash).

Full level-5 cycle on S1-ecv-02 (13.NE): a placeholder peer 192.0.2.77 (RFC 5737) added under a confirm window, verified present with both working EVPN peers byte-identical, confirmed, rolled back, and the result byte-identical to the pre-change baseline for both the neighbour table and the system object. hasUnsavedChanges False at both ends. Needed NO --override-template: the bgp template governs timers, not peers (spec 004). Two defects had to be fixed first, both invisible to any read-only check — see the sitrep. A peer create must carry a COMPLETE object: the appliance defaults password/rtmap_inbound/rtmap_outbound to '' and strict verify then fails, which is D7's materialization requirement and is T8's to solve generally.

Orchestrator-scope, one object per appliance (/appliance/extraInfo?nePk=). Read sweep over 18 appliances clean; no-op round trip planned empty; on S2-EC-01 the country was changed and verified with every other field untouched, then rolled back byte-identical to the baseline, and a fresh session re-read the same. Persistence is the Orchestrator's own database (no appliance flash, no saveChanges in the path); the fresh-session re-read is the persistence evidence this object admits. Live objects carry null for never-set fields; the canonical form treats null and "" alike.
